modules.name: Complaint Management
modules.description: Lets residents raise complaints and lets admins and assigned persons track and close them with status visibility.

modules.name: Visitor Management
modules.description: Lets gate security check or add visitors quickly and keep a record in place of the paper register.

requirements.title: Admin view of all complaints across projects
requirements.description: The Raghuvir Admin must be able to see and control all complaints across 10+ projects and know each complaint's status without a phone call.

requirements.title: Assigned person task list
requirements.description: The Assigned Person must see a clear task list showing which work to do and where.

requirements.title: Close work with a photo
requirements.description: The Assigned Person must be able to close work with a photo.

requirements.title: Resident raises complaint and sees status
requirements.description: A Resident must be able to raise a complaint once and see it through to closure, including whether anyone is working on it.

requirements.title: Quick approvals and checks for Society Manager
requirements.description: The Society Manager must be able to approve and check requests in a few taps on mobile.

requirements.title: Mobile-first access for Society Manager, Resident and Watchman
requirements.description: The Society Manager, Resident and Watchman work on mobile only or mainly, so the system must be usable on mobile.

requirements.title: Gujarati and Hindi language support
requirements.description: The Resident may prefer Gujarati and the Watchman prefers Gujarati or Hindi, so the system must support these languages.

requirements.title: Fast visitor check and entry
requirements.description: The Watchman must be able to check or add a visitor in under 30 seconds and keep a record of visitors.
